title: Exciting App Updates from VOOL Mobile
seoTitle: Exciting Updates from VOOL Mobile App
description: What's new on VOOL Mobile App? Learn about the Guest Car mode, and how we've enhanced the charger and LMC detail views.
body:
After a considerable journey, we are thrilled to share some noteworthy news and updates regarding the VOOL mobile app.

Introducing simple price-based charging for OCPP chargers

Charging in 'EV' Mode is a variant of our Smart Charging feature within the VOOL mobile app, designed for individuals who prefer not to connect their EVs to our platform or are unable to do so.


We provide users with the capability to configure price-based charging when an OCPP-compatible charger is integrated with the VOOL system.

For more information about the EV mode, please visit this link.

Guest Car view in VOOL mobile app

Enhanced Charger and LMC Detail Views

Experience our updated charger and LMC detail views once you've connected the devices to your VOOL account. Easily access device settings and gain valuable insights at your fingertips, including the ability to review the details of each charging session.

Please ensure you update the app to the latest version in order to access these new views.

Charger view in VOOL Mobile App


We value your input. Is there anything else you would like to see included here?

Give us feedback!
